encounter.text: A dormouse with an improbably large pack has set up a makeshift stall between two fungal columns. The pack is open, revealing rows of stoppered vials and waxed cloth bundles, each one labelled in a spidery hand. 'Fresh from the deep caps!' they announce, adjusting their spectacles. 'Nothing that'll kill you outright, I promise. Probably.'

choices.text: Buy the Mole's Vitality Brew they have on the shelf.
Pocket something while they look away.

sample.text: The dormouse selects a vial after much deliberation and hands it over. 'This one's a mild restorative — warm, slightly mushroomy, does what it says. No charge. Good advertising.' You drink it. They weren't lying.

caught.text: The dormouse's hand snaps out and catches your wrist with surprising force. 'I count everything,' they say pleasantly. 'Three times. Before opening.' They let go and reach under the stall. 'I do appreciate boldness, however. So this one's educational rather than fatal.'

items.name: Paralytic Tincture
items.description: A precisely measured dose of something deeply unpleasant.
